page.layout: One page of verse in a single column, centred-ragged, with a line of author initials ("I. I. B.") at the right after the text. Below it a small printer's ornament. Catchword "MARTI-" at the lower right. Running head centred above the text, page number at the top left.
page.notes: Printer's ornament (small woodcut device) below the text; not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse page on the right margin, ignored. The word "vigilésque" carries an accent-like mark on the é as printed; read with reasonable confidence. The first line of "Desficit" is set with a ligature (ss) that reads as Des-ficit; transcribed with plain s. Long s normalised to s throughout. Catchword "MARTI-" is the first word of the next page, printed with a hyphen as shown.
